attribution: Representative sample entries for UX/demo. Not official Games Workshop text. Build full corpus locally with npm run corpus:build-wh40k.

entries.explanation: When attacking with a Lance weapon, add 1 to the wound roll if the attacking unit made a charge move this turn.
entries.citation: Warhammer 40,000 11th ed Core Rules, p. 82 — Lance (24.21) (sample)

entries.explanation: Players spend Command Points on stratagems to create epic tactical moments when a critical point in the battle is reached, where extra effects can tip the balance in their favour. See the core rules PDF (rule 15.01) for how to use them and for individual stratagem cards.
entries.citation: Warhammer 40,000 11th ed Core Rules, p. 54 — Stratagems (15.01) (sample)

entries.explanation: Close quarters rules apply only during the Engagement phase. Outside Engagement, this keyword does not affect play.
entries.citation: Warhammer 40,000 11th ed Core Rules — close quarters (sample)

entries.explanation: Engagement is the phase where close-quarters and fight rules apply. Keywords tied to Engagement are irrelevant outside it.
A battle round consists of alternating player turns through movement, shooting, charge, and fight phases.
entries.citation: Warhammer 40,000 11th ed Core Rules — battle round (sample)

entries.explanation: During the Charge phase, eligible units declare charges against enemy units within range.
entries.citation: Warhammer 40,000 11th ed Core Rules — charge phase (sample)

entries.explanation: Units that charged or are within engagement range fight in the Fight phase, alternating activations.
entries.citation: Warhammer 40,000 11th ed Core Rules — fight phase (sample)

entries.explanation: Units move across the battlefield in the Movement phase, respecting coherency and terrain rules.
entries.citation: Warhammer 40,000 11th ed Core Rules — movement phase (sample)

entries.explanation: Units that lost models may need to take a Battle-shock test during the Morale phase.
Objective markers define scoring locations. Controlling them earns victory points each round.
entries.citation: Warhammer 40,000 11th ed Core Rules — objective marker (sample)

entries.explanation: Units with ranged weapons attack eligible targets during the Shooting phase.
entries.citation: Warhammer 40,000 11th ed Core Rules — shooting phase (sample)

entries.explanation: Terrain features can block line of sight, provide cover, and restrict movement.
